# DR Congo OpenSourceRail Campaign
<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-marketing-campaigns.py. -->

National outreach package covering **7 catalogued cities**. Values
below aggregate city screening models; the national brief separately treats the
shared manufacturing plant.

## Audience

- DR Congo ministry responsible for transport and urban mobility
- DR Congo national climate, energy or Green Climate Fund authority
- DR Congo public investment, planning or finance authority
- Embassy or High Commission of DR Congo in the United Kingdom — economic section

## National proposition

| Measure | Catalogue result |
|---|---:|
| Population represented | 27,007,000 |
| Lines / route length | 28 / 858 km |
| Fleet | 1,280 trainsets |
| City programme CAPEX | $8.13 B |
| Local capital and value allocation | $6.05 B (74%) |
| Station/depot PV / storage | 119.3 MW / 724.5 MWh |
| Illustrative external-capital saving | $12.55 B |

Lead with a government-reviewed pilot, local manufacturing and construction,
open standards, renewable-energy integration and independently checked demand,
environmental, social and engineering studies.
